[[Droknar's Flatbow]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[bow]] obtained from the [[Ranger's Chest]] at the [[Epilogue]].

==Stats==
:[[Piercing damage]]: 15-28 (Requires 9 [[Marksmanship]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Ivory Bow]]; however, the color is a bluish green.

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, it is possible to create an exact technical replica for this item with:
*One of the following [[flatbow]]s:
**[[Feathered Flatbow]] from collectors [[Rahvu]], [[Pathfinder Alon]], or [[Pekk]] or crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]] or [[Kol Swordshanks]]
**[[Flatbow (feathered)|Flatbow]] from collectors [[Ohtah]] or [[Guard Captain Mirkoz]]
**[[Destroyer Flatbow]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
**[[Imperial Flatbow]] from collector [[Shen Xi]]
**[[Tormented Flatbow]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
OR
*One of the following [[flatbow]]s:
**[[Feathered Flatbow]] from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Sende]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
**[[Asuran Flatbow]] from crafter [[Nojj]]
**[[Balthazar's Flatbow]] from collector [[Zaishen Martial Weapon Master]]
**[[Deldrimor Flatbow]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]]
**[[Flatbow of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]]
**[[Norn Flatbow]] from crafter [[Keti]]
**[[Oppressor's Flatbow]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]]
**[[Charr Flatbow]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]])
**[[Mursaat Flatbow]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Tengu Flatbow]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
**[[Undead Flatbow]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack)
*[[Perfect]] [[Sundering]] [[Bow String]]
*[[Perfect]] [[Bow Grip]] [[of Fortitude]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Inscription|Strength and Honor]]" inscription

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Drago's Flatbow]], [[Urgoz's Flatbow]], and [[Nooseknitter's Flatbow]] have stats identical to this item.
*The following bows have stats identical to this item; however, they are different bow classes:
**[[Koren's Hornbow]], [[Droknar's Hornbow]]
**[[Forgotten Longbow]], [[Urgoz's Longbow]], [[Arachni's Longbow]], [[Droknar's Longbow]], [[Deldrimor Longbow (unique)]]
**[[Stygian Recurve Bow]], [[Droknar's Recurve Bow]] 
**[[Uhiwi's Shortbow]], [[Urgoz's Shortbow]], [[Ashlyn's Shortbow]], [[Droknar's Shortbow]]
